title: HVAC Amp Draw vs Nameplate
description: Measure blower and compressor running current with the clamp and compare against nameplate FLA/RLA limits.

steps.title: Safety And Setup
steps.instruction: SAFETY: Confirm PPE and that the clamp is rated for the circuit voltage. Record nameplate FLA (blower/fan) and RLA (compressor). Clamp one conductor at a time. The absolute limits below are typical residential defaults - update them to the unit's nameplate.
steps.note_prompt: Record blower FLA and compressor RLA from the nameplate.

steps.title: Measure Blower/Fan Amps
steps.instruction: With the blower running, set the meter to AC current and clamp the blower motor conductor. Capture the running current. It should not exceed the fan motor nameplate FLA.

acceptance.description: Default residential blower FLA limit; set to the unit nameplate FLA.

steps.note_prompt: Record blower amps vs nameplate FLA.

steps.title: Measure Compressor Amps
steps.instruction: With the compressor running at steady state, clamp the compressor conductor and capture the running current. It should not exceed the compressor nameplate RLA.

acceptance.description: Default residential compressor RLA limit; set to the unit nameplate RLA.

steps.note_prompt: Record compressor amps vs nameplate RLA.

steps.title: Record Result
steps.instruction: Document the readings. Amps above nameplate indicate a mechanical, electrical, or refrigerant-charge problem and should be investigated.
